mapper.select: SELECT funding_id AS fundingId, user_id AS userId, title, description, max_price AS maxPrice, current_price AS currentPrice, image_path AS imagePath, status, reject_reason AS rejectReason, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM funding WHERE status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT funding_id AS fundingId, user_id AS userId, title, description, max_price AS maxPrice, current_price AS currentPrice, image_path AS imagePath, status, reject_reason AS rejectReason, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM funding WHERE funding_id = #{fundingId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO funding ( user_id, title, description, max_price, current_price, image_path, status, reject_reason, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{maxPrice}, #{currentPrice}, #{imagePath}, #{status}, #{rejectReason}, NOW(), NOW() )
